machine.text: Qalisa imiyalo kukhompyutha yakho, nezinhlelo namaseva ayo, njengeseva yokuthuthukisa yesayithi. I-JavaScript ne-Python kuhlala kukhompyutha ehlukanisiwe kule thebhu.
machine.on: Imisebenzi enefolda {folder} iqalisa imiyalo yayo kule khompyutha, ngamunye ubuzwe kuqala, uze ucindezele u-Ctrl+C kutheminali yayo.
machine.question: Qalisa lokhu kukhompyutha yakho, efoldeni {folder}?
machine.app: Imiyalo ingaqalisa nakule khompyutha, nezinhlelo namaseva ayo, efoldeni oyikhethayo: imisebenzi enaleyo folda iqalisa imiyalo yayo lapho.
machine.failed: Akuqalanga: kudinga i-Node.js kule khompyutha, umyalo othi node oqaliswa yitheminali.
machine.on.app: Imisebenzi enefolda {folder} iqalisa imiyalo yayo kule khompyutha, ngamunye ubuzwe kuqala.
machine.lede: Imisebenzi isebenzisa ikhompyutha ehlukanisiwe kule thebhu, ngaphandle kwaleyo esefoldeni oyixhuma kule khompyutha.
machine.step.paste: Namathisela lo mugqa lapho, bese ucindezela u-Enter.
machine.step.wait: Kulindwe ukuthi umugqa uqaliswe: leli khasi liyabona ngokwalo.
machine.secret: Ukukopisha kuthatha umugqa wonke, nokhiye wawo. Kugcine kuwe: kuvumela leli khasi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha yakho.
